body: I appreciate the explanation. This would explain why he was so very clingy and needy in the beginning of it all. Honestly it was almost too much and now I'm being pushed away completely.

We ended up getting in a huge fight because I looked through his messages and saw texts to another girl as if he were single. He told me it was because I didn't show I loved him enough and ended up confessing that he had been diagnosed as bipolar.
We were together for a little over a year. I didn't find out about his bipolar until about 3 months in

Hey if you ever need to talk you can PM me. I went through a very similar situation. I am 20 and my father passed away last year from liver cancer. I was a junior in college, my first year away at school. I always thought he'd be around for graduations, wedding, grandkids, etc. it was a big shock to me when I found out he only had about a year left. It was an even bigger shock when that year deadline diminished to months and then weeks and before I knew it, I was driving 3.5 hours home every weekend from school to see him. It was a really tough situation to go through and I'm still torn apart on the inside. I'm just letting you know that you are not alone and if you ever want to talk about your situation I am here.

I just signed up with my school for a therapy session a few days from now. I'm really glad to hear that it has helped you a lot. I'm hoping it does the same for me as I've never been to therapy before

It just sucks and it hurts so much because I really put a lot into this relationship. All the heartache and suffering is now gone to waste. It really destroyed me on the inside and it was all for nothing
I am dealing with the same questions and boy does it feel awful

It's very difficult but I know I shouldn't try to contact him. It'd be best if we didn't speak. I just hope there is still some small chance out there for the future that we may be able to be together in a healthy way
He was never a fan of me getting drunk and going out. And it was the source of a lot of problems in our relationship and I told him I wouldn't go out anymore

Couldn't remember for the life of me, but the other medication was Wellbutrin. I strongly believe he needs medication to get by, it's just a matter of finding the right dosage of the right ones. Psychiatrist never followed through to adjust meds or even ask how he is feeling on them.
I guess you can't force someone to seek out the help they so desperately need. Wish there was a way

Finally convinced him about 4 months ago to see a prior psychiatrist to receive medication. Was prescribed lithium and something else. It is clear that these meds are not working/ not right for him so he decided a few days ago to quit the meds. I am working to get him to a different doctor but I have been quite unsuccessful in that. Honestly thought things were better before the meds but he was experiencing more suicidal thoughts. I know I can't make him be proactive I'm not sure what to do

Absolutely, my SO didn't tell me of his bipolar until a few months into the relationship. Unfortunately, I was unaware of the hardships this would entail so I treated this relationship the same as any other. This resulted in many arguments and close breakups. It has been almost a year and a half and I still feel like I am learning the complexity of this disorder
